R-hierarchy.reason: The trip hero photo, Fraunces trek title, Day 1 plan card, packing progress/action, and itinerary stages establish a clear visual hierarchy without unrelated elements competing.

R-fill.reason: Only the primary Packing list/Pack next item CTA button and matching Day 1 active accent use a saturated fill against neutral tonal surfaces.

R-surfaces.reason: Calm surfaceContainerLow side panes and surfaceContainerHigh cards create distinct grouping while tonal container roles highlight state and key pills.

R-controls.reason: All interactive controls (back and share icon buttons, full-width primary pill button, FilterChips, and SegmentedListItems) look distinct and tappable with no floating text-only buttons.

R-font.reason: Bundled Fraunces gives expressive weight to the Everest Base Camp Trek headline and large section titles while Google Sans Flex handles body/labels and Google Sans Code with tnum handles elevations and counts.

R-platform.reason: The layout follows Android Material 3 conventions with a TopAppBar back arrow, tonal share action, edge-to-edge Scaffold content, and SegmentedListItems free of iOS disclosure chevrons or Cancel/Done actions.

R-text.reason: Across all five renders (light, dark, foldable, tablet, desktop), all labels, cards, chips, and itinerary rows remain unclipped and non-overlapping.

R-dark.reason: In main-dark.png, all icons, headings, body text, badges, progress indicator, and button labels have strong contrast against dark surfaces and light primary fills.

R-adaptive.reason: The layout adapts across breakpoints from a single-column phone view to side-by-side cards and two-column 6-day itinerary on foldable, a two-pane view revealing the Ascent profile and full packing checklist on tablet, and a three-pane layout on desktop.

R-idea.reason: The Alpine Journal direction pairs Fraunces editorial titles and monospace elevation/distance readouts with a snowy camp hero, wavy packing progress indicator, Day 1 to Day 6 stage badges, and an elevation bar chart.

R-semantics.reason: All section headings apply Modifier.semantics { heading() }, ItineraryRow uses SegmentedListItem(selected = ...), and packing rows use SegmentedListItem with Role.Checkbox semantics and Checkbox(onCheckedChange = null).

R-fields.reason: The proposal contains no text input or search fields.

R-visibility.reason: Conditional panes, the ModalBottomSheet, and day-plan transitions use when/if blocks and AnimatedContent rather than zero-alpha hiding.

R-blur.reason: The proposal uses no Modifier.blur anywhere.

R-trek-forms.reason: Each content type uses a distinct form (cover photo with opaque tertiaryContainer countdown pill, summary card, wavy progress bar, Ascent profile bar chart, and segmented itinerary/checklist rows) and the text over the photo sits on a solid pill for clear legibility.
